editorial.blurb: A warm, unpretentious spot in Hyde Park where authentic Indian curries and Southern comfort food coexist on separate menus, each executed with genuine care and flavor.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the butter chicken combo or lamb curry with samosa and roti for dipping—the vegan and vegetarian curries are standouts, and the fresh juices (guava and mango) are a hidden gem; arrive hungry since portions are generous and service is cafeteria-style fast.
